metadataRaw.title: One Move for Less Sciatica Pain at Night
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy exercise to help relieve — and even prevent — nighttime sciatica pain.

It works by reducing tension and pressure along the entire sciatic nerve pathway, from the lower back down to the leg and foot.

The best part? You can do it right at the edge of your bed, even in the middle of the night.

Give it a try and let us know how it works for you!
